title: Resilient stream propagation: inject correlation headers and per-route metadata for function/tool calls
author: Priya Desai
release_notes: Propagate a lightweight correlation header to downstream tool/function executions and attach per-route tags to runtime metrics and JSONL access logs. Improves debugability for streaming and tool-invocation failures without changing public API contracts.
body: Motivation: We have recurring postmortems where partial streaming failures or dropped tool executions were difficult to correlate to the originating HTTP request because trace context or any stable correlation id was not consistently carried onto the tool/function execution path or into per-route metrics. This PR introduces a small, backwards-compatible observability surface that makes end-to-end correlation and per-route attribution easier while keeping the OpenAI-compat API unchanged. Summary of changes: 1) Add a short-lived correlation header X-RW-Corr-ID for every incoming API request. The value is generated once at the HTTP ingress and propagated on internal RPCs and to any tool/function invocations. 2) Ensure W3C traceparent (and optional baggage) is forwarded into function-tool workers where available; when tracing headers are absent we fall back to X-RW-Corr-ID so logs and metrics still join correctly. 3) Tag runtime metrics and JSONL access logs with route_name and model_variant labels (route-level keys) emitted as route.{route_name} and variant.{model_variant} tags to make per-endpoint SLO dashboards work without additional sampling. 4) Harden the streaming handshake: add an idempotent handshake ack path so retries during partial disconnects don't produce duplicate function calls; this is gated behind a feature flag and defaults on. 5) Add end-to-end tests that simulate network/backpressure interruptions and assert correlation id preservation and single tool execution. Checklist: - [x] Generate X-RW-Corr-ID at ingress - [x] Propagate traceparent/baggage when present - [x] Propagate correlation header to tool/function runner invocation layer - [x] Emit route_name and model_variant tags in runtime metrics pipeline - [x] Update JSONL access log format to include corr_id and route tags - [x] Add unit and e2e tests for streaming reconnect and tool-call dedupe - [x] Docs: add observability note to api/observability.md Rollout plan: feature is hidden behind the flag runtime.observability.corr_headers.enabled=true by default in staging. We will enable in 2 phases: enable for internal staging tenants for 48 hours and validate dashboards and error budgets, then enable globally. If we see duplicated tool executions beyond a safe threshold we will flip the handshake ack to off and revert with a toggle (no code rollout required). Backwards compatibility: Public OpenAI-compat API surface unchanged. The new X-RW-Corr-ID is internal-only and does not affect clients unless they observe additional headers in responses (we do not return the header to public responses). Testing notes: added e2e harness tests under telemetry/integration that spin up a mock tool-runner and assert a single execution and preserved corr_id across reconnections. Logs: sample JSONL change: {"timestamp":"...","req_id":"abc","corr_id":"rwd-xyz","route":"chat.completions","model":"gpt-4o-mini","status":"stream-closed"}. Monitoring: dashboards updated to include corr_id cardinality histograms and new per-route latency percentiles. Related: ENG-4821 (streaming resilience), ENG-4990 (tool-call observability).
commits: generate corr id at http ingress and carry to rpc layer
propagate traceparent and baggage into tool-runner context
emit route_name and model_variant tags from runtime metrics emitter
add handshake ack path and dedupe logic in stream broker
update JSONL access log serializer to include corr_id and route tags
add unit and e2e tests for reconnect scenarios
docs: observability note and rollout instructions
reviews: Ethan Morales (request changes): The handshake ack looks reasonable but we need stronger invariants around idempotency at the tool-runner boundary. Can you add an explicit dedupe token persisted for the short TTL? Author reply: Added dedupe token store in runner/context.go and unit tests that assert single execution under concurrent reconnects.

Sofia Chen (approved): Verified metrics emission locally; the per-route tag cardinality looks safe for our current routes. Please ensure we don't accidentally tag high-cardinality input fields. Author reply: Confirmed we only tag route_name and model_variant, not user-provided identifiers.
Marco Ruiz (comment): CI flaked once on streaming_integration, reran and passed. Author reply: Added a small backoff to the integration harness to reduce race flakiness.
merge_details: Squash merged into main by Sofia Chen on 2026-02-10. Merge commit message: "Add correlation header propagation, route tags, and stream handshake dedupe". Rollout started behind feature flag; monitoring alert added to SRE playbook for increased duplicate-exec rate.
notes_for_release: Enable behind runtime.observability.corr_headers.enabled=true. No public API changes. Operators should watch duplicated tool_execution_count and corr_id cardinality for anomalies.
